title: oom-oracle values
description: A typo in a value is silent: the key is ignored, the default is rendered, and the DaemonSet installs cleanly. This schema turns that into a failure at `helm install` instead.

global.description: Injected by Helm for subcharts. Unused here, but rejecting it would break `--set global.*` on a parent chart.

digest.description: Overrides repository and tag entirely. Must include the algorithm prefix.

detector.description: ebpf never falls back and fails to start when the kernel refuses, which is what you want if inferred victims are not acceptable.

pollInterval.description: Go duration. Ignored under the eBPF detector, which is event-driven.

sampleInterval.description: Go duration. With history, sets how much trajectory exists when a kill lands.

history.description: Samples retained per container. 60 at 1s is the minute the trajectory chart draws.

retain.description: Reports held in memory per node. There is no persistence.

cgroupPrefix.description: Absolute path. "/" watches the whole hierarchy.

kubernetes.description: off yields UID-only reports. auto degrades to that with a logged reason. on refuses to start rather than degrade.

listen.description: host:port, bound inside the pod. Changing the port here without changing service.port leaves the probes pointing at nothing.

extraArgs.description: Appended verbatim. hack/verify-chart-flags.sh does not check these, so a flag the daemon has never heard of crash-loops on every node.

port.description: Must agree with the port in daemon.listen.

rbac.description: One rule: get, list and watch on pods. Disabling it yields UID-only reports unless something else grants them.

tolerations.description: An untolerated taint is a node with no OOM reporting and nothing saying so.

priorityClassName.description: system-node-critical keeps the agent from being evicted at the moment it exists for.

readinessProbe.description: /readyz means the probe is attached and the sampler holds history, not merely that the process started.

hostPaths.description: Both are mounted read-only. The daemon never writes to the node.
